reasons: Classification is correct: the audit right at p0073 has no frequency cap and no minimum notice (Licensee merely must permit an audit within 30 days of demand), so it fails the fallback's 'once per year on 15 days' notice' and edges into the rule's walk-away territory (effectively unlimited/unannounced audits).

Redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted rewrite of only the second sentence: annual cap, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, auditor confidentiality, and express no-system-access; the audit-scope sentence and the already-preferred 5% cost-shifting language at p0064 are correctly left untouched (no double-flagging or over-reaching).

The high changed-character ratio is explained by substituting the offending 'within 30 days of a written request' sentence with the required frequency/notice/cost-neutral limits; no customer-favorable term is removed and the direction of the edit favors our side.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, cites the playbook position and offers the 15-day/annual fallback.
